purpose: Workflow-aware static indicator explanation metadata for MacroAnalysis UI/API. Sentiment and expectation fields are rule seeds and display aids, not runtime-computed outputs.

do: 시장 해석에 필요한 맥락을 간결하게 제공한다.
상승/하락의 일반적 의미를 설명하되 단정적 투자 판단은 피한다.
AI 호출 없이 백엔드 또는 프론트에서 정적으로 소비할 수 있게 유지한다.
avoid: 초보자, 입문자 등 사용자를 낮춰 보일 수 있는 표현

field_definitions.key: Indicator key used by the existing collectors/API.
field_definitions.short_label: One-line UI label for cards, tooltips, or compact panels.
field_definitions.description: Plain-language explanation of what the indicator measures.
field_definitions.market_role: Why the market watches this indicator.
field_definitions.higher_meaning: Common interpretation when the value rises.
field_definitions.lower_meaning: Common interpretation when the value falls.
field_definitions.watch_points: Cautions and contextual signals to compare together.
field_definitions.sentiment_hint: Typical risk sentiment implication, not a trading signal.
field_definitions.related_indicators: Other indicator keys that help interpretation.
field_definitions.workflow_status: Clarifies whether the item is a runtime signal or static explanation metadata.
field_definitions.display_text: UI-safe text fields copied from existing explanation fields for frontend consumption.
field_definitions.analysis_hints: Static rule seeds for future sentiment/expectation workflows; not computed results.
field_definitions.analysis_hints.sentiment_mapping: General directional interpretation by value movement. Use only with runtime context.
field_definitions.analysis_hints.expectation_role: Which expectation axis this indicator can inform and which indicators should be cross-checked.

implementation_notes.recommended_backend_shape: Load this JSON once at startup and merge explanation metadata into /api/summary, /api/chart/{indicator_key}, /api/indicators/history/{indicator_key}, /api/sectors, and /api/fomc responses when matching keys exist.
implementation_notes.recommended_frontend_usage: Use short_label on compact cards and description/market_role/higher_meaning/lower_meaning/watch_points in side panels or info tooltips.
implementation_notes.fallback_behavior: If a key is missing, show display_name only and omit explanation blocks rather than calling AI dynamically.
implementation_notes.sentiment_policy: sentiment_hint is a heuristic explanation for interpretation only; do not convert it directly into a buy/sell signal.
workflow_connection_policy: sentiment_hint 및 analysis_hints.sentiment_mapping은 실제 sentiment 계산 결과가 아니라 정적 해석 규칙이다.
expectation 관련 필드는 실제 expectation 계산 결과가 아니라 향후 워크플로우 연결을 위한 해석 축이다.
프론트엔드는 워크플로우 연결 전까지 display_text를 기본 표시 대상으로 사용하고, analysis_hints는 보조 툴팁 또는 내부 로직 참고용으로 제한한다.
백엔드는 이 JSON만으로 sentiment/expectation API 응답값을 생성하지 말고, 별도 runtime 데이터와 계산 로직이 연결된 뒤 결과값을 노출한다.
